FieldSet.description: Fields reps can update on "Update Opportunity" in LINE (D-21, D-31, D-46). Order here = order on the form. Required flags follow the rep's Opportunity layout and the database; ticking Required here makes a field required on the form as well. BA's list (2026-11-03): Stage, Amount, Main PreSales Engineer (User lookup), Next Step (custom), Next Step Due Date. Contains org fields that exist in TerraSky Thailand orgs (P3 exception, D-46).
